custom_steps:
1. Click Order on Part Request 2.
  2. Open purchase order A from the Purchase Orders list (Parts in the top bar, then Purchase Orders in the left menu).
  3. Click Receive.
  4. Type an invoice number.
  5. Type 1 as the delivered quantity.
  6. Type 10.00 as the cost.
  7. Click Receive to accept the delivery.
  8. Open work order 1's Parts tab.
  9. Click Pick on the received part A.
